# Route mode renders a raw element server-side from the same `element`
# declaration the client render reads. It used to read none of it: every tag
# came out as the fallback <div> with the tag carried alongside as an
# attribute (`<div tag="span">`), the wildcard attribute map never unpacked
# into the attributes it was written under, `textContent` was written as an
# attribute rather than as the element's text, a style struct was dropped, and
# a false boolean attribute was emitted as `open="false"` — which is open.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/server.go

# The tag prop names the element; it is the tag, and never an attribute.
grep '<details>' out/server.go
grep '<span>' out/server.go
grep '<my-widget id=' out/server.go
! grep 'tag=' out/server.go
! grep '<element' out/server.go

# An attribute nobody declared reaches the element through the wildcard prop,
# under the name it was written with.
grep 'role=' out/server.go

# A style struct is a set of CSS declarations.
grep 'display:inline-block;min-width:40px' out/server.go

# textContent is the element's text, not an attribute of it.
grep '<button>go</button>' out/server.go
! grep 'textContent=' out/server.go

# A false boolean attribute is absent, not `open="false"`.
! grep 'open=' out/server.go

# All of the above is a claim about a Go file, so compile it.
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/route-raw

go 1.23
-- api/api.go --
package api

func Bump(n int) int { return n + 1 }
-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { go { html } }

import "go:example.com/route-raw/api"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component main node {
    var n int = 0

    window #app(title = "t", href = "/") {
        html.div(role = "main", style = { display = Display.inlineBlock, minWidth = 40 }) {
            html.details(open = false) {
                html.button(textContent = "go", @click { n = api.Bump(n) })
            }
            html.span(textContent = "{string(n)}")
            html.element(tag = "my-widget", id = "w")
        }
    }
}
